segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: Oh, the hum you hear right now isn't music — it's radio waves coming from deep space, slowed down so you can hear them.

segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: We're really far out now, and the machines here aren't really on any planet — they're just falling through the dark.

segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: Some of them have been falling for fifty years.
